$ type build/sim/97506dd064c7cb51/dpt.net     (generated netlist, nominal point)
* Double-pulse test: NTH4L022N120M3S  (generated by dpt.netlist, key 97506dd064c7cb51)
.lib "<repo>/third_party/onsemi/onsemi_sicmosfet_1200m3s_ltspice/ONSEMI_SiCMOSFET_1200M3S_ltspice.txt"
.param Vbus=800 Lloop=3e-08 Lcs=0
.temp 25
* --- DC link: source ramps up so the initial operating point is trivial
Vbus vin 0 PWL(0 0 2e-06 {Vbus}) Rser=10m
Cbus vin 0 1e-05 Rser=2m
Lbus vin bus_p {Lloop/2} Rser=0.1m
* --- high side: freewheeling device
Vihs bus_p hs_d 0
XHS hs_d hs_g hs_s hs_ks NTH4L022N120M3S_4P
Vhss hs_s sw 0
Vhsoff hs_drv hs_ks -3
Rghs hs_drv hs_g 4.5
Lload bus_p sw 0.0001 Rser=10m
* --- low side: device under test
Vid sw dut_d 0
XLS dut_d dut_g dut_s dut_ks NTH4L022N120M3S_4P
Lsrc dut_s 0 {Lloop/2} Rser=0.1m
* --- gate driver (ideal source, double pulse as PWL)
Vdrv drv0 dut_ks PWL(0 -3 3e-06 -3 3.05e-06 18 7.99e-06 18 7.995e-06 -3 8.995e-06 -3 9e-06 18)
Rdrv0 drv0 drv 1u
Rg drv dut_g 4.5
.tran 0 9.495e-06
.options plotwinsize=0 solver=alt abstol=1e-7 vntol=1e-4 cshunt=1e-21
.save V(dut_d) V(dut_s) V(dut_g) V(dut_ks) V(bus_p) V(sw) V(hs_g) V(hs_ks) I(Vid) I(Vihs) I(Lload)
.end

$ LTspice.exe -b dpt.net   ->  dpt.log (excerpt)
